rooms.name: Cellar
rooms.desc: A damp cellar. Rough stairs lead north.

rooms.name: Great Hall
rooms.desc: A great hall with doors east, west and a heavy iron door north.

rooms.name: Armory
rooms.desc: Racks of rusted weapons. One sword still gleams.

rooms.name: Library
rooms.desc: Dusty shelves. A passage leads north into the dark.

rooms.name: Dragon Lair
rooms.desc: Heat and the smell of sulphur. Gold glitters under a huge shape.
